author: AirPano VR
description:
Don't forget that this is 360 video: you can change the angle of view.

The tropical rainforests of Venezuela are full of natural wonders. Rivers, waterfalls, and majestic tepuis (tabletop mountains) captivate travelers with their beauty. But reaching these places is no easy task—some can only be accessed by helicopter! Today, we're heading to one of these remote locations.

Our first destination is Churún Merú, also known as Dragon Falls. Located just 7 kilometers from its famous neighbor, Angel Falls, it rarely receives visitors. In fact, reaching it overland is even more challenging than getting to Angel Falls.
